summary: Unselected MD selector showed selected-profile ranking rows with repeated Decision Rank 1 values, which made blank assumptions look like a real ranking.
fix_summary: Added a selector-ready gate, disabled the selected-ranking export until all assumptions are selected, and rendered an explicit empty state for incomplete selector assumptions.

summary: Default rankings sort could place blank or unranked schools before numeric Decision Rank rows.
fix_summary: Changed generic table sorting so missing sort values always fall after present values.

summary: Long offscreen score-warning text made rankings table rows too tall and hard to scan.
fix_summary: In the main rankings table, replaced full warning text with a compact Has warnings badge and widened ranking/selector tables; full warning detail remains on school profile pages.
notes: This keeps the table usable while preserving detail elsewhere.

summary: School profile cards were too dense and long generated values such as school IDs could overflow or crowd narrow panels.
fix_summary: Increased profile card minimum width and allowed panel text to wrap within cards.
notes: Long identifiers can still wrap awkwardly, but they no longer overflow the card.

summary: Wide data tables require horizontal scrolling on mobile.
fix_summary: Deferred broader responsive table redesign to later UX slices.
notes: The current behavior is usable for tabular audit data and avoids changing table semantics in Slice A.

summary: Hidden-school review and dedicated dossier index views could not be screenshot-tested because those routes do not exist yet.
fix_summary: Deferred to Slice B visibility controls and Slice C minimal dossiers.
notes: Slice A captured existing rankings, methodology, school profile, selector, export-control, and mobile states only.
